mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_inspect_fingerprint (fp_hash, fp_key, app_id, has_stack, exc_simple, logger_class, biz_frame, msg_tpl, exc_cause, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, total_count, status, judge_state) VALUES
(#{i.fpHash}, #{i.fpKey}, #{i.appId}, #{i.hasStack}, #{i.excSimple}, #{i.loggerClass}, #{i.bizFrame}, #{i.msgTpl}, #{i.excCause}, #{i.firstSeenTime}, #{i.lastSeenTime}, #{i.totalCount}, #{i.status}, #{i.judgeState})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_seen_time = GREATEST(last_seen_time, VALUES(last_seen_time)), judge_state = VALUES(judge_state), msg_tpl = VALUES(msg_tpl), exc_cause = VALUES(exc_cause)
mapper.select: SELECT id, fp_hash, fp_key, app_id, has_stack, exc_simple, logger_class, biz_frame, msg_tpl, exc_cause, template_id, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, total_count, status, judge_state, severity, handled, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint WHERE deleted = 0 AND template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, fp_hash, fp_key, app_id, has_stack, exc_simple, logger_class, biz_frame, msg_tpl, exc_cause, template_id, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, total_count, status, judge_state, category, severity, handled, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint WHERE deleted = 0 AND template_id IS NULL ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id, f.fp_hash, f.fp_key, f.app_id, f.has_stack, f.exc_simple, f.logger_class, f.biz_frame, f.msg_tpl, f.exc_cause, f.first_seen_time, f.last_seen_time, f.total_count, f.status, f.judge_state, f.category, f.severity, f.handled, f.pushed_time, f.push_count, f.last_message_id, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.deleted FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint f WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.handled = 0 AND f.category IS NOT NULL AND f.category <> 'BIZ_EXPECTED' AND f.judge_state IN ('NEW', 'SURGE', 'RESURGENT') AND (f.pushed_time IS NULL OR f.pushed_time < #{dedupBefore}) ORDER BY FIELD(f.severity, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3'), f.last_seen_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT app_id AS appId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY app_id ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT f.id, f.fp_hash, f.fp_key, f.app_id, f.has_stack, f.exc_simple, f.logger_class, f.biz_frame, f.msg_tpl, f.exc_cause, f.first_seen_time, f.last_seen_time, f.total_count, f.status, f.judge_state, f.category, f.severity, f.handled, f.pushed_time, f.push_count, f.last_message_id, f.create_time, f.update_time, f.deleted FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint f LEFT JOIN ai_inspect_analysis a ON a.fp_id = f.id AND a.create_time >= #{since} WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.judge_state IN ('NEW', 'SURGE', 'RESURGENT') AND a.id IS NULL ORDER BY f.total_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint
ORDER BY last_seen_time DESC
ORDER BY total_count DESC, last_seen_time DESC
ORDER BY FIELD(severity, 'P0', 'P1', 'P2', 'P3') ASC, severity IS NULL ASC, last_seen_time DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
